afterFileEdit.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,subprocess; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''); target='examples/card-krueger-toy/src/did_analysis.py'; sys.exit(0 if not p.endswith(target) else subprocess.call([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','examples/card-krueger-toy/tests','-q']))"

python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''); sys.exit(0) if not p.endswith('examples/card-krueger-toy/data/toy_fast_food.csv') else print('[Hook] Raw data file was edited. Verify this was intentional. AGENTS.md prohibits modifying raw data.', file=sys.stderr)"

afterShellExecution.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; json.load(sys.stdin); print('[Hook] Verification run complete. Check output above before proceeding.')"

stop.command: python3 -c "import datetime; open('notes/orchestration_log.md','a').write('| '+datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')+' | Agent stopped | — | Review diff before merge |\n')"
